description: Find Kroger-family grocery stores and supermarkets near a US ZIP code — covers Kroger, Ralphs, Fred Meyer, King Soopers, Fry's, Harris Teeter, QFC, Smith's, Dillons, Food 4 Less, Mariano's and more. Returns store names, addresses, phone, hours, and the location_id needed for price lookups. Example: kroger_store_locator({ zip_code: "45202" })

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own Kroger API credentials as "client_id:client_secret" (free at developer.kroger.com)

zip_code.description: US ZIP code to search near, e.g. "45202"
